title: Some locations, chosen for maximum Mall Worldliness
content: I have several dream locations but don't want this post to get too long, so I'll just share a couple. 1. Hotels 2. Train exchange and airport 3. Toy store and water park **Hotels** There are several **hotels.** One hotel was supposedly located in Saudi Arabia, but you wouldn't know it outside of some vaguely Arabic decor on the inside. Few veiled women, alcohol being served on every corner, massive casino. Oh man the casino took up a whole section of the lower floor. Red carpets and gold trim. The lower floor itself was like an octagon with the entrance to the casino on three sides, a giant plant in the middle, the Golden Elevator on the side opposite the casino, and random shops on the other sides. The elevator was all gold decorated hence the name, and would travel in inconceivable directions to get where it was going. Rooms were numbered with three numbers as if they were coordinates in a 3D space. 001 002 003 type of thing. 100 100 100 was the very top room, where I needed to go. A different hotel I saw on a group trip with a bunch of people had hallways that would just go on forever and every room was number 200 for some unknown reason. The lobby was dilapidated and smelled of cigarette smoke. We were supposed to stay there overnight and I didn't want to because it was so creepy. Employees would appear out of nowhere like ghosts, maybe they were ghosts. We set off to find our rooms but of course they're all room 200. Only one of the doors opened so that must have been it. We got inside and it's just all white, no windows, and only a single mattress on the floor with burn marks on it. The floor had burn marks too. **Train exchange and airport** The **transportation exchange** is made of glass walls arranged to form cube-like structures. When I was in it last, I was headed to China. There are wacky elevators that go multiple directions like the "Saudi" hotel complex. Small trains take you where you need to go. There are various restaurants like "Croatian Station" which served Croatian fast food. Some of the trains had built-in meal services too because the trips could take hours, that's how big this place was. There was surprisingly little security. As in, none. **Toy store and water park** This is a gigantic **toy store**, which goes on endlessly. But it's not a friendly place at all. It's cold like a freezer, every surface is metal, and the toys are all packaged in boxes with bland packaging. It's more like a warehouse crossed with a morgue, but it is a functioning store, and you can check out at a register with your toy of choice. Can you actually *leave*? (Aside from just waking up from the dream) Great question. There is a **water park** that I understand to be in the same area as the toy store. It has the same cold vibes, and is entirely indoors. It's not possible to see the end of the building. There is one massive green plastic tube-slide, and once you go up you have to slide down, no chickening out now. But unlike, you know, any actual water park, it's not clear where the slide actually ends. It doesn't matter. You're going down whether you like it or not.
